platforms.name: KZSU Stanford Music Submission Portal and Physical Mail
platforms.country: United States / Stanford, California university radio with worldwide online streaming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; optional physical media, packaging and international postage are sender-funded.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KZSU publishes an official send-music portal and physical-mail addresses, but the music system requires a temporary browser cookie and secure session before its guidelines or fields can be reviewed. A human must open the first-party route, inspect the current requirements and consent, select digital or physical delivery, prepare the assets, and complete any submission manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KZSU first-party Contact, homepage, Schedule and music-system pages. The Contact page links a dedicated send-music route, lists KZSU Music, P.O. Box 20510, Stanford, CA 94309-0510 for postal delivery and KZSU, Memorial Hall, 540 Memorial Way, Stanford, CA 94305 for UPS/FedEx, and publishes music@kzsu.stanford.edu for the Music Directors. The music portal redirects to zookeeper.stanford.edu and requires a small temporary cookie to verify the browser and maintain a secure session; no cookie was accepted and the underlying fields, rights language, file limits and possible runtime controls were not inspected. The email was verified as a plaintext first-party Music Director business contact, but the dedicated portal and published postal routes remain the authoritative submission paths for this record. Current activity was confirmed through the first-party currently-on-air page, live streams, archive player, schedule system and current staff listing. No email, portal field, file or physical package was prepared or submitted.

platforms.name: WCBN Hard-Copy Album Airplay Submission
platforms.country: United States / Ann Arbor, Michigan student-run freeform radio with worldwide online streaming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; hard-copy media, packaging and international postage are sender-funded.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WCBN accepts music from any musician who sends a hard copy of an album, preferably on CD or vinyl, and permits genre-specific care-of routing. A human must confirm that an eligible album and physical medium exist, select the appropriate general or specialist department, verify the current address, prepare the package, and approve production and postage before shipment.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from WCBN first-party Contact, homepage and Schedule pages. The authorized route is WCBN MUSIC, WCBN-FM, 515 E. Jefferson St. (530 Student Activities Bldg.), Ann Arbor, MI 48109-1316. WCBN says it accepts music from any and all musicians willing to send a hard copy of their album, preferably CD or vinyl, listens to everything received and gives every submission a chance with its DJs. Genre-specific releases may be addressed care of the relevant director, such as jazz or hip-hop; otherwise they go to WCBN MUSIC. A Music Directors email is displayed through a protected or redacted first-party link in passive extraction and was not decoded, guessed or used as a digital submission route. Current activity was confirmed through the station statement that it broadcasts 24/7, live stream and archive links, an active schedule page, current 2025-2026 board terms and current staff listings. No email, physical medium, package or shipment was prepared.

platforms.name: KDVS Genre-Directed Physical Music Submission
platforms.country: United States / Davis, California student-run community freeform radio with worldwide web streaming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical media, packaging and international postage are sender-funded.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KDVS explicitly requires physical submissions and publishes separate USPS and UPS/FedEx addresses plus specialist routing for electronic, experimental, hip-hop, punk and metal. A human must select the correct department, confirm the release format and current postal details, prepare the package, and approve production and postage before shipment.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KDVS first-party FAQ, Contact, homepage and Weekly Top 30 pages. For UPS/FedEx, the route is KDVS 90.3 FM, ATTN: MUSIC DEPARTMENT, 14 Lower Freeborn, UC Davis, Davis, CA 95616. For USPS, it is ATTN: MUSIC DEPARTMENT, ASUCD-KDVS, University of California, 1 Shields Ave, Davis, CA 95616. The FAQ permits replacing the department line with METAL DEPT., HIP HOP DEPT., PUNK DEPT., ELECTRONIC DEPT. or EXPERIMENTAL DEPT. The Contact page publishes musicdept@kdvs.org for music review, library maintenance, mail sorting and label contact, while explicitly stating that all new music must be sent to the mailing address and that submissions are physical-only; the email is therefore verified as a business contact but not queued as a digital submission inbox. Current activity was confirmed through the live web player, current staff listings, schedule and charts including a Weekly Top 30 dated 2026-03-10. No email, physical medium, package or shipment was prepared.
